name: Tosk Albanian

ancestors.notes: Standard Albanian is codified on the basis of Tosk; grapheme inventory and letter values are shared. Wikipedia: Tosk 'serves as the basis of the standard Albanian language'.

notes: Tosk Albanian, spoken south of the Shkumbin river; the dialectal basis of the Standard Albanian literary language, so its Latin alphabet and grapheme-to-IPA mapping are inherited unchanged from sq. Historically distinguished from Gheg by: preservation of consonant clusters mb/ngj/nd where Gheg assimilates to m/nj/n; rhotacism of Proto-Albanian *-n- to -r- (e.g. rëra 'sand'); and vowel developments (Proto-Albanian *ō > va, *â+nasal > ë, e.g. nëntë 'nine'). These are historical/diachronic facts, not orthographic divergences from the standard, so no distinct grapheme table is asserted here.
